lessons.title: Revisit- Good manners and golden words
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To reinforce polite behavior. Activity: Discuss situations to use golden words and show good manners.

lessons.title: Letter Tt
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To master writing the letter Tt. Activity: Complete workbook exercises for Tt.

lessons.title: Orange
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To reinforce recognition of the color orange. Activity: Complete color-related workbook activities.

lessons.title: Revisit – Healthy and unhealthy food
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To consolidate learning about nutrition. Activity: Review healthy vs. junk foods.

lessons.title: Recap
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To recap previously learned letters. Activity: Complete letter recap exercises.

lessons.title: Near and Far
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To understand the spatial concepts of near and far. Activity: Observe pictures and identify proximity.

lessons.title: Revisit – Plants
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To reinforce plant-related topics. Activity: Oral review of plants and their needs.

lessons.title: Recap
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To further review previously learned letters. Activity: Complete workbook recap exercises.

lessons.title: Near and Far
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To reinforce spatial awareness. Activity: Complete workbook exercises for near and far concepts.

lessons.title: Revisit – Things we get from plants
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To review what plants provide. Activity: Discuss fruits, vegetables, and other plant products.

lessons.title: Revisit Letters Kk to Tt
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To consolidate learning of uppercase letters Kk through Tt. Activity: Comprehensive oral and written review.

lessons.title: Revisit – Numbers 11 to 20, shapes and colour
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To review numbers, recently learned shapes, and colours. Activity: Comprehensive review and practice.

lessons.title: Revisit – Fruits and Vegetables
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To review fruits and vegetables. Activity: Oral recap and identification.

rhymes.title: Prayer
rhymes.content: Learning Goal: To instil a sense of gratitude and routine. Activity: Recitation. Detailed procedure: Guide students to fold their hands and close their eyes while reciting the prayer together.

rhymes.title: Greeting Song
rhymes.content: Learning Goal: To learn social etiquette and morning greetings. Activity: Singing with actions. Detailed procedure: Stand in a circle and sing the greeting song, waving to peers.

rhymes.title: Five Little Fish
rhymes.content: Learning Goal: To practice reverse counting and rhythm. Activity: Finger play. Detailed procedure: Show five fingers and fold one down with each verse as the fish swim away.

rhymes.title: Busy Bee
rhymes.content: Learning Goal: To encourage cleanliness and helping at home. Activity: Action rhyme. Detailed procedure: Mime sweeping, raking, and washing hands along with the rhyme.

rhymes.title: Simple Simson
rhymes.content: Learning Goal: To develop phonetic awareness. Activity: Rhyme recitation. Detailed procedure: Read aloud with emphasis on rhythm and rhyming words.

rhymes.title: Months of The Year
rhymes.content: Learning Goal: To learn the days in each month. Activity: Calendar rhyme recitation. Detailed procedure: Recite the poem to remember which months have thirty or thirty-one days.

rhymes.title: Sun, Moon and Stars
rhymes.content: Learning Goal: To introduce celestial bodies. Activity: Point and say. Detailed procedure: Point upwards to the sky, and twinkle fingers for stars.

rhymes.title: Shapes
rhymes.content: Learning Goal: To identify circles, squares, rectangles, and triangles. Activity: Tracing shapes in the air. Detailed procedure: Make shapes in the air with fingers while reciting the properties of each shape.

rhymes.title: In the heart of a seed
rhymes.content: Learning Goal: To understand plant germination. Activity: Seed visualization. Detailed procedure: Curl up like a seed and slowly 'grow' tall while the poem is read.

rhymes.title: Animal Homes
rhymes.content: Learning Goal: To identify where animals live. Activity: Matching actions. Detailed procedure: Call out the animal and have students mimic its home or sound.

rhymes.title: The Hen has a Chicken
rhymes.content: Learning Goal: To learn animal sounds and their young ones. Activity: Animal sounds play. Detailed procedure: Make the animal sounds mentioned in the rhyme (cheep, bow, quack).

rhymes.title: The Little Plant
rhymes.content: Learning Goal: To reinforce the life cycle of a plant. Activity: Growth enactment. Detailed procedure: Crouch down like a seed and slowly stand up to mimic a growing plant.

rhymes.title: Pease Porridge Hot
rhymes.content: Learning Goal: To develop rhythm and hand-clapping coordination. Activity: Partner clapping. Detailed procedure: Pair students to clap hands together to the beat of the rhyme.

rhymes.title: Days Of The Week
rhymes.content: Learning Goal: To memorize the days of the week in order. Activity: Sequence chanting. Detailed procedure: Recite the days, clapping on each day to set a steady rhythm.

rhymes.title: Rectangle Is The Window
rhymes.content: Learning Goal: To relate 2D shapes to real-world objects. Activity: Object finding. Detailed procedure: Point to real windows, doors, and balls as the shapes are mentioned in the rhyme.

rhymes.title: Five Lovely Flowers
rhymes.content: Learning Goal: To practice subtraction and counting down. Activity: Finger counting. Detailed procedure: Hold up five fingers and put one down as each flower faces a challenge.

rhymes.title: Doe A Deer
rhymes.content: Learning Goal: To introduce musical notes. Activity: Singing. Detailed procedure: Sing the notes with simple hand gestures for each pitch.

rhymes.title: Tomatoes Are Red
rhymes.content: Learning Goal: To reinforce color and vegetable recognition. Activity: Color pointing. Detailed procedure: Show a red tomato and ask students to point to other red objects.

rhymes.title: Dashing Through The Snow
rhymes.content: Learning Goal: To learn about winter themes. Activity: Jingling action. Detailed procedure: Pretend to ride a sleigh and shake imaginary bells.

rhymes.title: Miss Polly Had A Dolly
rhymes.content: Learning Goal: To act out caring for a sick doll and calling a doctor. Activity: Role-play. Detailed procedure: Use a doll to act out the steps—calling the doctor and giving a pill.

rhymes.title: Hickety Pickety My Black Hen
rhymes.content: Learning Goal: To learn counting and farm animals. Activity: Counting eggs. Detailed procedure: Hold up fingers to represent the number of eggs laid by the hen.

rhymes.title: Wee Willy Winkie
rhymes.content: Learning Goal: To encourage healthy bedtime routines. Activity: Bedtime mime. Detailed procedure: Pretend to knock on the window and sleep.

rhymes.title: Cobbler Cobbler
rhymes.content: Learning Goal: To learn about community helpers. Activity: Mending mime. Detailed procedure: Pretend to tap and stitch shoes while reciting.

rhymes.title: Little Boy Blue
rhymes.content: Learning Goal: To recognize farm animals. Activity: Horn blowing action. Detailed procedure: Mime blowing a horn and sleeping under a haystack.

rhymes.title: Bubble Bubbles
rhymes.content: Learning Goal: To imagine floating and blowing bubbles. Activity: Bubble blowing. Detailed procedure: Mime blowing and popping bubbles in the air.

rhymes.title: Neddy Had Nine Teddies
rhymes.content: Learning Goal: To practice counting and bedtime routines. Activity: Teddy counting. Detailed procedure: Count to nine on fingers and pretend to put teddies to bed.

rhymes.title: Bingo
rhymes.content: Learning Goal: To practice spelling and rhythm. Activity: Clapping spelling. Detailed procedure: Clap for each missing letter in B-I-N-G-O to build phonetic memory.

rhymes.title: Bear Went Over The Mountain
rhymes.content: Learning Goal: To encourage exploration. Activity: Marching. Detailed procedure: March in place as the bear goes over the mountain and river.

rhymes.title: To Market, To Market
rhymes.content: Learning Goal: To learn about shopping and animals. Activity: Trot in place. Detailed procedure: Bounce gently on the spot mimicking a jiggety-jog ride.

rhymes.title: Mulberry Bush
rhymes.content: Learning Goal: To learn daily routines (washing face, brushing teeth). Activity: Daily routine mime. Detailed procedure: Act out the routines mentioned while walking in a circle.

stories.title: The Three Sheep
stories.content: Learning Goal: To understand overcoming obstacles using smart thinking. Activity: Story narration. Detailed procedure: Use distinct voices for Ben, Jen, Ken, and the monster to highlight character differences.

stories.title: Elephant And Friend
stories.content: Learning Goal: To value friendship beyond physical appearance. Activity: Role-play listening. Detailed procedure: Ask children to mimic the animals the elephant meets to show understanding of the characters.

stories.title: The Honest Woodcutter
stories.content: Learning Goal: To understand the value of honesty. Activity: Moral discussion. Detailed procedure: Tell the story of the woodcutter and God, then ask questions about why telling the truth is important.

stories.title: The Sun And The Cloud
stories.content: Learning Goal: To see that goodness and strength overcome negativity. Activity: Story comprehension. Detailed procedure: Narrate the interaction between the sun, birds, black cloud, and wind, encouraging children to express the emotions.

lessons.title: Recap Small case a-z letters
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To recap small case letters a-z. Activity: Writing and tracing practice. Detailed procedure: Instruct students to trace and write small case letters in their skillbook.

lessons.title: Thick and Thin
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To differentiate between thick and thin objects. Activity: Object comparison. Detailed procedure: Show examples of thick and thin objects and have students complete the textbook exercises.

lessons.title: All about me
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To encourage self-recognition, express individual preferences, and state basic personal facts. Activity: Oral introduction. Detailed procedure: Conduct an oral session asking simple questions such as 'What is your name?', 'What is your age?', and 'Name your favourite toy.'

lessons.title: Recap Aa- Zz
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To recap both capital and small case letters. Activity: Alphabet recognition and writing. Detailed procedure: Practice writing upper and lower case letters sequentially.

lessons.title: Front and Back
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To understand the spatial concepts of front and back. Activity: Visual identification. Detailed procedure: Demonstrate front and back using classroom objects and guide students through the workbook activities.

lessons.title: Activity Drawing- Myself
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To build self-awareness through art. Activity: Self-portrait drawing. Detailed procedure: Provide paper and crayons for students to draw a picture of themselves.

lessons.title: Activity
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To reinforce alphabet recognition and phonics. Activity: Tracing words. Detailed procedure: Have students complete the word tracing activities in their skillbook.

lessons.title: Up and Down
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To understand the directional concepts of up and down. Activity: Physical and visual exercise. Detailed procedure: Ask students to point up and down, then complete the textbook pages.

lessons.title: Sense Organs
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To identify the five sense organs and their functions. Activity: Matching and discussion. Detailed procedure: Discuss eyes, ears, nose, tongue, and skin. Complete the matching activities in the book.

lessons.title: Activity
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To practice vocabulary and letter formation. Activity: Tracing and matching. Detailed procedure: Instruct students to trace the words provided in the skillbook.

lessons.title: Open and Closed
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To identify states of being open and closed. Activity: Identification. Detailed procedure: Show open and closed boxes or doors. Instruct students to complete the corresponding worksheets.

lessons.title: Sense Organs Exploration
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To explore the senses practically. Activity: Sensory game. Detailed procedure: Bring different items to class for smelling, touching, looking at, or listening to.

lessons.title: Activity
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To learn the use of 'a' and 'an'. Activity: Filling in articles. Detailed procedure: Explain when to use 'a' and 'an' and have students practice in their skillbooks.

lessons.title: Recap 1 to 50
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To recite and write numbers from 1 to 50. Activity: Number grid completion. Detailed procedure: Have students fill in the missing numbers in the 1 to 50 grid.

lessons.title: Revisit – All About Me/Sense Organs Activity
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To consolidate knowledge about oneself and the five senses. Activity: Oral quiz. Detailed procedure: Ask students questions combining personal facts and which sense organ they use for different actions.

lessons.title: Long Vowel Sound
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To recognize and pronounce long vowel sounds. Activity: Reading aloud. Detailed procedure: Read out words with long vowel sounds and have students repeat and complete the skillbook exercise.

lessons.title: Backward counting
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To count backward from 50. Activity: Balloon countdown. Detailed procedure: Practice counting backward orally, then complete the backward counting exercise in the book.

lessons.title: Internal Body Parts
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To identify internal body parts like brain, heart, and lungs. Activity: Diagram labeling. Detailed procedure: Explain the main internal organs and their basic functions. Guide students to complete the labeling.

lessons.title: Long Vowel 'a'
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To practice reading and writing words with the long 'a' sound. Activity: Word writing. Detailed procedure: Guide students to write words like cake, fake, jail, brain in their workbooks.

lessons.title: Before/After/Between
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To understand number sequence and positioning. Activity: Number placement. Detailed procedure: Use a number line to demonstrate numbers that come before, after, or between others.

lessons.title: Internal Body Parts Activity
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To reinforce the names and locations of internal organs. Activity: Hands-on placement game. Detailed procedure: Use a cutout of a human body and have students place paper organs in the correct spots.

lessons.title: Long Vowel 'a'
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To reinforce the long 'a' sound. Activity: Word selection and writing. Detailed procedure: Have students choose the correct long 'a' word for each picture and write it.

lessons.title: Activity/Recap
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To review ascending and descending order and number sequences. Activity: Workbook exercises. Detailed procedure: Complete the ascending and descending order practice boxes.

lessons.title: Daily Routine and Good Habits
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To distinguish between good and bad habits. Activity: Picture identification. Detailed procedure: Discuss daily routines like brushing teeth and bathing. Have students write down the good habits shown.

lessons.title: Long 'a' vowel Words - Activity
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To apply knowledge of long 'a' words. Activity: Word sorting or matching game. Detailed procedure: Conduct a classroom game using flashcards of long 'a' words.

lessons.title: Tens and Ones
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To introduce the concept of place value up to 50. Activity: Block counting. Detailed procedure: Explain tens and ones using visual blocks and have students write the corresponding numbers.

lessons.title: Activity – Role Play Good Habits
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To practice good habits through action. Activity: Role playing. Detailed procedure: Ask students to mime activities like washing hands, throwing garbage in a bin, and making a bed.

lessons.title: Revisit – Long 'a' vowel sentence
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To form simple sentences using long 'a' words. Activity: Sentence creation. Detailed procedure: Give students simple long 'a' words and ask them to form short sentences verbally.

lessons.title: Revisit – Backwards counting and Before/After/Between
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To consolidate backwards counting and sequence concepts. Activity: Blackboard exercises. Detailed procedure: Write numbers on the board and ask students what comes before, after, or between.

lessons.title: Revisit – Internal Body Parts/Daily Routine and Good Habits
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To review internal body parts and daily habits. Activity: Q&A session. Detailed procedure: Conduct a quick recap asking students to name internal organs and share one good habit they practiced today.

lessons.title: Long Vowel 'e'
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To learn the long 'e' vowel sound. Activity: Word and picture matching. Detailed procedure: Instruct students to trace words that have the long 'e' sound and tick correct pictures.

lessons.title: Number Names
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To learn number names from 1 to 10. Activity: Tracing number names. Detailed procedure: Instruct students to trace and write the words 'One' to 'Ten'.

lessons.title: My Family
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To identify family members and relationships. Activity: Discussion. Detailed procedure: Talk about mothers, fathers, siblings, and grandparents. Discuss family trees.

lessons.title: Long Vowel 'e' Words – Game
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To practice the long 'e' sound playfully. Activity: Word recognition game. Detailed procedure: Use the board or flashcards to play a game identifying long 'e' words vs short 'e' words.

lessons.title: Number Names
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To learn number names from 11 to 20. Activity: Tracing number names. Detailed procedure: Instruct students to trace and write the words 'Eleven' to 'Twenty'.

lessons.title: Role Play - My Family
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To understand family roles. Activity: Role playing. Detailed procedure: Assign roles of different family members to students and have them act out a brief daily scenario.

lessons.title: Long Vowel 'e'
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To practice spelling long 'e' words. Activity: Word writing. Detailed procedure: Instruct students to trace and write words like beat, leak, seed, year, hear.

lessons.title: Number names
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To reinforce number names from 11 to 20. Activity: Counting and writing. Detailed procedure: Have students count stars and trace/write the corresponding number name.

lessons.title: My Family
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To personalize family knowledge. Activity: Family scrapbook activity. Detailed procedure: Instruct students to write the names of their family members and paste their pictures in the workbook.

lessons.title: Long vowel 'e' Words – Activity
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To strengthen vocabulary with long 'e' sounds. Activity: Group activity. Detailed procedure: Write words on the board and have students identify which ones have a long 'e' sound.

lessons.title: Number Names Puzzle
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To recognize number names in a puzzle format. Activity: Puzzle solving. Detailed procedure: Provide a simple word search or matching puzzle for number names 1-20.

lessons.title: Safety at home
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To understand basic safety rules at home. Activity: Safety discussion. Detailed procedure: Discuss the dangers of playing with fire, sharp objects, or wet floors. Have students cross out dangerous situations in the book.

lessons.title: Revisit – Long vowel 'e' Sentence
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To read and construct sentences with long 'e' words. Activity: Reading aloud. Detailed procedure: Write simple sentences on the board (e.g., 'I see a green tree') and read them together.

lessons.title: Revisit – Number Names
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To test knowledge of number names 1-20. Activity: Oral recitation. Detailed procedure: Have students orally spell the number names randomly written on the board.

lessons.title: Revisit – My Family and Safety at Home
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To review family structures and home safety. Activity: Group discussion. Detailed procedure: Ask students to name one family member and one safety rule they follow at home.

lessons.title: Long Vowel 'i'
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To learn the long 'i' vowel sound. Activity: Word recognition and writing. Detailed procedure: Practice writing words with long 'i' sounds, distinguishing them from short 'i'.

lessons.title: Number Names (21-30)
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To learn number names from 21 to 30. Activity: Tracing number names. Detailed procedure: Instruct students to trace and write the words 'Twenty one' to 'Thirty'.

lessons.title: Types of Houses
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To identify different types of houses. Activity: Visual identification. Detailed procedure: Show pictures of different houses (apartments, bungalows, huts) and circle the houses in the workbook.

lessons.title: Long Vowel 'i' Words – Game
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To practice identifying long 'i' words. Activity: Sorting game. Detailed procedure: Sort flashcards into long 'i' and short 'i' piles.

lessons.title: Number names Activity
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To review number names 1-30. Activity: Dictation. Detailed procedure: Call out random numbers from 1 to 30 and have students write the number names in their rough books.

lessons.title: Drawing Activity Houses
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To visualize different houses. Activity: Drawing. Detailed procedure: Provide drawing materials and ask students to draw their own house or a house they like.

lessons.title: Long Vowel 'i'
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To spell and write long 'i' words. Activity: Writing practice. Detailed procedure: Have students complete the long 'i' writing exercise in the workbook.

lessons.title: Number names (21-30)
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To reinforce number names from 21 to 30. Activity: Writing practice. Detailed procedure: Have students fill down the numbers from 21 to 30 in their workbooks.

lessons.title: My School
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To identify parts of a school and classroom. Activity: Vocabulary building. Detailed procedure: Discuss the playground, classroom, blackboard, and library. Look at the school picture in the book.

lessons.title: Long vowel 'i' Words – Activity
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To use long 'i' words contextually. Activity: Fill in the blanks. Detailed procedure: Create a few sentences on the board with missing long 'i' words for students to fill.

lessons.title: Number names Matching
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To link numerals to their number names. Activity: Matching game. Detailed procedure: Provide a worksheet or board activity drawing lines from numbers (21-30) to their words.

lessons.title: Activity School Tour
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To observe the school environment firsthand. Activity: School walk. Detailed procedure: Take the class on a brief tour of the school, identifying key areas like the principal's office, playground, and washrooms.

lessons.title: Revisit – Long i sentences
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To read sentences containing long 'i' words confidently. Activity: Group reading. Detailed procedure: Read a short paragraph together focusing on long 'i' vocabulary.

lessons.title: Revisit – Number names
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To assess learning of number names 1-30. Activity: Quick oral test. Detailed procedure: Ask students individually to spell specific numbers between 1 and 30.

lessons.title: Revisit – Types of Houses and My School
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To consolidate vocabulary related to housing and school. Activity: Picture description. Detailed procedure: Show pictures of a house and a school and ask students to point out specific features.

lessons.title: Long Vowel 'o'
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To introduce the long 'o' vowel sound. Activity: Word reading and tracing. Detailed procedure: Present words like goat, rope, rose. Instruct students to trace the words in their skillbook.

lessons.title: Number Names (31-40)
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To learn number names from 31 to 40. Activity: Tracing number names. Detailed procedure: Instruct students to trace and write the words 'Thirty one' to 'Forty'.

lessons.title: Activity
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To identify classroom objects. Activity: Tracing names. Detailed procedure: Instruct students to trace names like books, cupboard, blackboard, and classroom.

lessons.title: Long Vowel 'o' Words – Game
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To practice long 'o' sound recognition. Activity: Phonics game. Detailed procedure: Say a word and have students stand up if it has a long 'o' sound and sit down if it doesn't.

lessons.title: Number names Activity
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To reinforce number names 31-40. Activity: Missing letters. Detailed procedure: Write number names on the board with missing letters for students to complete.

lessons.title: Activity
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To recognize danger signs. Activity: Hazard identification. Detailed procedure: Instruct students to put a cross on dangerous activities depicted in the book.

lessons.title: Long Vowel 'o'
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To write and practice long 'o' words. Activity: Word writing. Detailed procedure: Have students write long 'o' sound words in their workbooks.

lessons.title: Number names (31-40)
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To memorize number spelling. Activity: Independent writing. Detailed procedure: Have students practice writing the number names 31-40 in their workbooks.

lessons.title: Activity Puzzle
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To encourage problem-solving and critical thinking. Activity: Solving a simple puzzle. Detailed procedure: Give students a simple physical puzzle related to classroom items to solve in groups.

lessons.title: Long vowel 'o' Words – Activity
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To correctly apply long 'o' words. Activity: Fill-in-the-blank sentences. Detailed procedure: Write sentences on the board and have students select the correct long 'o' word to fill the gap.

lessons.title: Number names Matching
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To match numerals to words. Activity: Draw the line. Detailed procedure: Draw numbers on one side of the board and words on the other, asking students to draw lines matching them.

lessons.title: Revisit – All about me
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To review personal details. Activity: Oral presentation. Detailed procedure: Have a few students come to the front and state 3 facts about themselves.

lessons.title: Revisit – Long o sentences
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To review long 'o' sounds in sentences. Activity: Sentence reading. Detailed procedure: Read simple short stories focusing on long 'o' vocabulary.

lessons.title: Revisit – Number names
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To review spelling of numbers 1-40. Activity: Spelling bee. Detailed procedure: Conduct a small spelling bee for the number names learned so far.

lessons.title: Revisit – Sense Organs
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To test recall of sense organs. Activity: Flashcards. Detailed procedure: Hold up pictures of actions and have students shout out the corresponding sense organ.

lessons.title: Long Vowel 'u'
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To introduce the long 'u' sound. Activity: Word writing. Detailed procedure: Instruct students to trace and learn long 'u' words such as cube, suit, tube.

lessons.title: Number Names (41-50)
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To learn number names 41 to 50. Activity: Writing and counting. Detailed procedure: Teach the spelling pattern for 'forty' and have students write names up to fifty.

lessons.title: Revisit - Internal Body Parts
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To review internal body parts. Activity: Body map. Detailed procedure: Point to parts of the torso/head and ask students which internal organ is located there.

lessons.title: Long Vowel 'u' Words – Game
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To practice the long 'u' sound playfully. Activity: Picture matching game. Detailed procedure: Match flashcards of words to their corresponding images.

lessons.title: Number names (41-50)
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To practice writing number names. Activity: Workbook exercises. Detailed procedure: Complete the workbook page covering the numbers 41 through 50.

lessons.title: Revisit – Daily Routine and Good Habits
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To review the importance of good habits. Activity: Habit sorting. Detailed procedure: Give students a list of actions and ask them to classify them as 'Good Habit' or 'Bad Habit'.

lessons.title: Long Vowel 'u'
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To write and recognize long 'u' words. Activity: Independent writing. Detailed procedure: Have students write out words like glue, cute, duty, tube in their workbooks.

lessons.title: Tens and Ones
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To understand place value tens and ones. Activity: Counting blocks. Detailed procedure: Demonstrate how to group items into tens and remaining ones.

lessons.title: Revisit – Safety at Home
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To review home safety. Activity: Oral discussion. Detailed procedure: Discuss the 'why' behind safety rules. E.g., 'Why shouldn't we play with sharp objects?'

lessons.title: Revisit – Long Vowel a, e, i words
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To review multiple long vowel sounds. Activity: Vowel sorting. Detailed procedure: Provide a list of words and have students group them by their vowel sound.

lessons.title: Revisit – Backwards Counting
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To test backward counting ability. Activity: Rocket launch countdown. Detailed procedure: Pretend to launch a rocket and have the class count backward from 50 aloud.

lessons.title: Revisit – My Family
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To review vocabulary related to family. Activity: Draw and tell. Detailed procedure: Ask students to draw their favorite family activity and describe it to the class.

lessons.title: Revisit – Long vowel o, u words
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To review the final long vowel sounds. Activity: Dictation. Detailed procedure: Give a short dictation of long 'o' and 'u' words.

lessons.title: Revisit – Number Names
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To solidify spelling of numbers 1-50. Activity: Number name bingo. Detailed procedure: Play a simple bingo game using number names instead of numerals.

lessons.title: Revisit – Types of Houses and My School
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To review community environments. Activity: Model building or drawing. Detailed procedure: Build a small school or house using building blocks or draw one on the board collectively.

lessons.title: Consonants and Vowels
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To distinguish between vowels and consonants. Activity: Vowel identification. Detailed procedure: Introduce the 5 vowels (A, E, I, O, U) and explain that the remaining letters are consonants. Instruct students to complete the worksheet identifying them.

lessons.title: Numbers 51-53
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To recognise and write numbers 51 to 53. Activity: Number tracing and writing. Detailed procedure: Guide the students to trace the numbers 51, 52, and 53, counting aloud as they write.

lessons.title: Healthy and Unhealthy Food
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To differentiate between healthy and unhealthy food items. Activity: Group discussion. Detailed procedure: Show pictures of various foods and discuss why items like fruits are healthy and junk food is unhealthy.

lessons.title: Activity
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To practice identifying consonants and vowels. Activity: Sorting letters. Detailed procedure: Provide a mix of letters and have students circle the vowels and underline the consonants.

lessons.title: Numbers 54-56
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To recognise and write numbers 54 to 56. Activity: Number practice. Detailed procedure: Instruct students to trace and write the numbers sequentially.

lessons.title: Activity Sorting healthy and unhealthy food
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To apply knowledge of food choices. Activity: Sorting game. Detailed procedure: Provide flashcards of different foods and have students sort them into 'Healthy' and 'Unhealthy' baskets.

lessons.title: Sight words (first 15 words)
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To recognize common sight words. Activity: Reading aloud. Detailed procedure: Show sight word flashcards one by one. Read them aloud and have the class repeat.

lessons.title: Numbers 57-59
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To recognise and write numbers 57 to 59. Activity: Number practice. Detailed procedure: Instruct students to trace and write the numbers sequentially.

lessons.title: Plants
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To learn about different types of plants. Activity: Picture observation. Detailed procedure: Point out the differences between big trees, small shrubs, and herbs.

lessons.title: Sight words (From 16 to 27 words)
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To recognize more sight words. Activity: Word matching. Detailed procedure: Continue with the next set of sight words on the board, pointing and reading together.

lessons.title: Number 60 and Before/After/Between
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To reach number 60 and understand sequence. Activity: Number line practice. Detailed procedure: Teach the number 60. Then use a number line to show numbers before, after, and between.

lessons.title: Activity / Types of plants
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To categorize plants. Activity: Worksheet filling. Detailed procedure: Instruct students to complete the exercises identifying shrubs, herbs, climbers, and creepers.

lessons.title: Revisit – consonants/vowels and sight words
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To review the week's literacy concepts. Activity: Quick quiz. Detailed procedure: Randomly ask students to identify a letter as a vowel/consonant or read a sight word from a card.

lessons.title: Numbers 51-60
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To consolidate numbers from 51 to 60. Activity: Sequence writing. Detailed procedure: Instruct students to fill in the missing numbers in the 51-60 sequence.

lessons.title: Revisit – healthy and unhealthy food/ plants
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To test recall on food and plant types. Activity: Oral Q&A. Detailed procedure: Ask students to name one healthy food, one unhealthy food, and one type of plant.

lessons.title: ‘L’ Blend word
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To introduce consonant blends with 'L' (bl, cl, fl, gl, pl, sl). Activity: Phonics reading. Detailed procedure: Read out words like 'blue', 'clap', 'flag' and emphasise the blending sound.

lessons.title: Before/After/Between
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To reinforce number sequencing. Activity: Missing numbers. Detailed procedure: Write number sets on the board and ask students to fill in the blanks before, after, or between them.

lessons.title: Activity
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To reinforce plant identification. Activity: Worksheet practice. Detailed procedure: Have students complete the workbook pages matching plant types.

lessons.title: ‘L’ Blend word
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To practice writing 'L' blend words. Activity: Tracing and writing. Detailed procedure: Have students trace words containing 'L' blends in their skillbook.

lessons.title: Before/After/Between (51-60)
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To master sequencing specifically between 51 and 60. Activity: Workbook exercise. Detailed procedure: Instruct students to complete the before/after/between exercises for numbers 51-60.

lessons.title: Germination
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To understand how a seed grows into a plant. Activity: Visual storytelling. Detailed procedure: Explain the steps of germination: seed, seedling, sapling, plant.

lessons.title: ‘L’ Blend word
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To reinforce 'L' blend phonics. Activity: Word completion. Detailed procedure: Instruct students to fill in the missing 'L' blend to complete the picture name.

lessons.title: Activity
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To practice ascending and descending order. Activity: Sequencing numbers. Detailed procedure: Have students arrange scrambled numbers from smallest to largest and vice versa.

lessons.title: Activity
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To sequence the germination process. Activity: Tracing and writing. Detailed procedure: Have students trace the words 'Seed', 'Seedling', 'Sapling', and 'Plant'.

lessons.title: ‘L’ Blend word
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To apply 'L' blends in reading. Activity: Reading sentences. Detailed procedure: Guide students to read short sentences containing 'L' blend words in the workbook.

lessons.title: Activity
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To reinforce ascending and descending concepts. Activity: Workbook completion. Detailed procedure: Instruct students to complete the ascending/descending exercises.

lessons.title: Activity – Sowing the seed
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To experience germination firsthand. Activity: Hands-on planting. Detailed procedure: Give each student a cup with soil and a seed to plant and water.

lessons.title: ‘L’ Blend word
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To independently use 'L' blend words. Activity: Fill in the blanks. Detailed procedure: Have students complete sentences by choosing the correct 'L' blend word.

lessons.title: Revisit – Before/After/Between And Ascending /Descending order
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To review number positioning and ordering. Activity: Board game. Detailed procedure: Call students to the board to arrange numbers in order or fill in missing middle numbers.

lessons.title: Revisit – Types of plants and Germination
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To consolidate learning about plant life. Activity: Discussion. Detailed procedure: Ask students to recall the steps of a seed growing and name a few plant types.

lessons.title: ‘R’ blend
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To introduce consonant blends with 'R' (br, cr, dr, fr, gr, pr, tr). Activity: Phonics reading. Detailed procedure: Read out words like 'crab', 'frog', 'tree' emphasizing the 'R' blend sound.

lessons.title: Tens and Ones
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To understand place value up to 60. Activity: Counting blocks. Detailed procedure: Show how numbers like 54 are made of 5 tens and 4 ones using visual aids.

lessons.title: Things we get from plants and trees
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To understand the uses of plants. Activity: Object discussion. Detailed procedure: Discuss items we get from trees like fruits, wood, paper, and rubber.

lessons.title: ‘R’ blend
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To practice writing 'R' blend words. Activity: Tracing and writing. Detailed procedure: Instruct students to sort and trace words under the correct 'R' blend heading.

lessons.title: Tens and ones
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To apply place value concepts. Activity: Workbook exercises. Detailed procedure: Have students count groups of tens and ones to form a complete number.

lessons.title: Activity
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To identify plant products. Activity: Colouring and ticking. Detailed procedure: Instruct students to colour the tree and tick the objects that come from trees.

lessons.title: ‘R’ blend
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To reinforce 'R' blend sounds. Activity: Fill in the missing letters. Detailed procedure: Have students look at pictures and complete the words with the correct 'R' blend.

lessons.title: Number Names
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To learn number names for 51-60. Activity: Writing practice. Detailed procedure: Guide students to trace and write the number names from 'Fifty one' to 'Sixty'.

lessons.title: Things that plants need to grow
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To learn the basic needs of a plant. Activity: Visual learning. Detailed procedure: Discuss how plants need sunlight, water, soil, and air to grow.

lessons.title: ‘R’ blend
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To read and identify 'R' blend words in context. Activity: Reading comprehension. Detailed procedure: Read a short passage containing 'R' blend words and answer simple questions.

lessons.title: Number Names
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To solidify spelling of number names 51-60. Activity: Workbook exercise. Detailed procedure: Have students practice writing the number names independently.

lessons.title: Activity Drawing Germination
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To visualize plant growth. Activity: Drawing. Detailed procedure: Provide paper and crayons for students to draw the stages of a plant growing from a seed.

lessons.title: ‘R’ blend
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To independently construct 'R' blend words. Activity: Fill in the blanks. Detailed procedure: Give sentences with missing 'R' blend words for students to complete.

lessons.title: Revisit – Number Names and Ones/Tens
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To review the week's math concepts. Activity: Dictation and Q&A. Detailed procedure: Dictate numbers for students to write as number names and ask how many tens/ones are in specific numbers.

lessons.title: Revisit – Plants and their uses
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To review what plants need and what they provide. Activity: Group recap. Detailed procedure: Ask questions about what we give plants (water) and what they give us (food, wood).

lessons.title: ‘S’ blend
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To introduce consonant blends with 'S' (sc, sk, sn, sp, st, sw, sm). Activity: Phonics reading. Detailed procedure: Read out words like 'scarf', 'snake', 'star' focusing on the 'S' blend sound.

lessons.title: High and low
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To compare high and low positions. Activity: Visual identification. Detailed procedure: Show pictures of objects placed high and low. Instruct students to colour accordingly.

lessons.title: Fruits
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To categorize fruits by seeds. Activity: Categorization. Detailed procedure: Teach students about fruits with single seeds, few seeds, and many seeds.

lessons.title: ‘S’ blend
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To practice writing 'S' blend words. Activity: Tracing. Detailed procedure: Instruct students to trace and copy words containing 'S' blends in their skillbook.

lessons.title: High and low
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To reinforce the concept of high and low. Activity: Workbook completion. Detailed procedure: Instruct students to identify and mark the high and low objects in their workbooks.

lessons.title: Activity
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To reinforce fruit categories. Activity: Matching. Detailed procedure: Have students match the picture of the fruit to its correct seed category box.

lessons.title: ‘S’ blend
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To apply 'S' blends in reading. Activity: Word completion. Detailed procedure: Have students look at the pictures and complete the words with the right 'S' blend.

lessons.title: Shape – Pentagon
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To introduce the pentagon shape. Activity: Tracing and colouring. Detailed procedure: Explain that a pentagon has 5 sides. Instruct students to trace, colour, and identify pentagon objects.

lessons.title: Activity Talk about their favourite fruits
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To practice oral expression and vocabulary. Activity: Oral sharing. Detailed procedure: Ask each student to name their favourite fruit and describe its colour or taste.

lessons.title: ‘S’ blend
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To use 'S' blends contextually. Activity: Fill in the blanks. Detailed procedure: Provide sentences and ask students to choose the correct 'S' blend word to complete them.

lessons.title: Skip count of 2’s
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To introduce skip counting by 2s. Activity: Number jumping. Detailed procedure: Use a number line to show jumping over one number to land on the next (0, 2, 4, 6...).

lessons.title: Activity-fireless cooking Fruit Salad
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To experience making a healthy snack. Activity: Fireless cooking. Detailed procedure: Teacher demonstrates mixing pre-cut fruits to make a simple fruit salad for the class.

lessons.title: ‘S’ blend
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To consolidate 'S' blend words. Activity: Independent workbook practice. Detailed procedure: Have students write out words and short phrases utilizing 'S' blends.

lessons.title: Skip count of 2’s
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To practice skip counting. Activity: Filling missing numbers. Detailed procedure: Instruct students to fill in the missing numbers counting by 2s to help the character reach the end.

lessons.title: Revisit – fruits
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To recall fruit facts. Activity: Flashcard quiz. Detailed procedure: Hold up flashcards of fruits and ask whether they have one seed, few seeds, or many seeds.

lessons.title: Blend words puzzle
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To test recognition of various blend words. Activity: Puzzle solving. Detailed procedure: Provide a simple word search or crossword puzzle featuring L, R, and S blend words.

lessons.title: Numbers 61-66
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To learn numbers 61 through 66. Activity: Number tracing. Detailed procedure: Introduce numbers 61-66 and have students trace them in the skillbook.

lessons.title: Vegetables
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To distinguish between underground and above-ground vegetables. Activity: Picture study. Detailed procedure: Show pictures and explain which vegetables grow under the soil and which grow above.

lessons.title: Sight words sentence reading
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To read sentences smoothly using sight words. Activity: Reading aloud. Detailed procedure: Write simple sentences using learned sight words on the board for students to read.

lessons.title: Numbers 67-70
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To learn numbers 67 through 70. Activity: Number tracing. Detailed procedure: Introduce numbers 67-70 and have students trace them to complete the set up to 70.

lessons.title: Activity
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To identify vegetable growth types. Activity: Worksheet filling. Detailed procedure: Have students circle above-ground vegetables and underground vegetables in their books.

lessons.title: Blend words Dictation
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To spell and write blend words. Activity: Dictation. Detailed procedure: Call out 5 to 10 simple blend words and have students write them down.

lessons.title: Number 61-70
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To reinforce writing numbers 61-70 sequentially. Activity: Independent writing. Detailed procedure: Have students write the numbers 61 to 70 independently in their workbooks.

lessons.title: Activity
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To spell vegetable names. Activity: Word writing. Detailed procedure: Have students use the hint box to write the correct names for the vegetables pictured.

lessons.title: Activity – identify the sight words in the newspaper/story book
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To recognize sight words in real-world texts. Activity: Word hunt. Detailed procedure: Provide old storybooks or newspapers and ask students to circle sight words they recognize.

lessons.title: Before/after/between (61-70)
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To understand sequencing for numbers 61-70. Activity: Worksheet completion. Detailed procedure: Instruct students to fill in the missing numbers before, after, or between the given 60s numbers.

lessons.title: Activity Sorting underground and above-ground vegetables
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To practically classify vegetables. Activity: Sorting game. Detailed procedure: Use plastic vegetables or flashcards and have students place them 'under the soil' (a brown cloth) or 'above'.

lessons.title: Revisit – Blends
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To review all blends learned so far. Activity: Phonics review. Detailed procedure: Quickly go through flashcards of L, R, and S blends and have the class sound them out.

lessons.title: Before/after/between 61-70
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To reinforce sequencing for numbers 61-70. Activity: Independent practice. Detailed procedure: Have students complete additional before, after, and between exercises in their workbooks.

lessons.title: Revisit – Vegetables
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To consolidate vegetable knowledge. Activity: Oral Q&A. Detailed procedure: Ask students to name two underground vegetables and two above-ground vegetables.

lessons.title: Revisit – Consonants
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To ensure mastery of consonants vs vowels. Activity: Board activity. Detailed procedure: Write words on the board and have students come up and circle only the consonants.

lessons.title: Ascending/Descending (61-70)
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To arrange numbers 61-70 in order. Activity: Sequencing. Detailed procedure: Explain arranging from smallest to largest and vice versa. Have students complete the skillbook exercise.

lessons.title: Flowers
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To identify common flowers. Activity: Vocabulary building. Detailed procedure: Show pictures of flowers like rose, hibiscus, marigold, and teach their names.

lessons.title: Revisit – Sight words
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To review all sight words taught. Activity: Sight word bingo. Detailed procedure: Play a simple bingo game using sight words to make the review fun.

lessons.title: Ascending/Descending (61-70)
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To reinforce ascending and descending concepts. Activity: Independent practice. Detailed procedure: Instruct students to arrange the jumbled numbers correctly in their workbooks.

lessons.title: Activity
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To observe flower characteristics. Activity: Matching and writing. Detailed procedure: Have students match flowers to their petals and write their names in the boxes provided.

lessons.title: Revisit L blend words.
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To review 'L' blend words. Activity: Picture naming. Detailed procedure: Show pictures and have students verbally identify them using the correct 'L' blend.

lessons.title: Tens and Ones
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To review place value up to 70. Activity: Block counting. Detailed procedure: Have students count tens and ones for numbers in the 60s and write the corresponding numerals.

lessons.title: Revisit – Plants and Types of plants
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To review plant categories. Activity: Recap discussion. Detailed procedure: Ask students to explain the difference between a shrub and an herb, providing examples.

lessons.title: Revisit – r blend words
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To review 'R' blend words. Activity: Reading practice. Detailed procedure: Read short sentences containing 'R' blends together as a class.

lessons.title: Number names 61-70
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To learn number names for 61-70. Activity: Writing and tracing. Detailed procedure: Instruct students to trace and write the number names 'Sixty one' to 'Seventy'.

lessons.title: Revisit – Germination
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To remember the plant life cycle. Activity: Sequence sorting. Detailed procedure: Scramble the stages of germination on the board and ask students to re-order them.

lessons.title: Revisit – s blend words
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To review 'S' blend words. Activity: Spelling bee. Detailed procedure: Conduct a mini spelling test or game focusing on 'S' blend words.

lessons.title: Number names 61-70
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To reinforce spelling of 61-70 number names. Activity: Independent writing. Detailed procedure: Have students practice writing the number names without tracing.

lessons.title: Revisit – Fruits and Vegetables
lessons.content: Learning Goal: To consolidate knowledge of fruits and vegetables. Activity: Show and tell. Detailed procedure: Bring a real fruit or vegetable and ask students to classify it and describe it.
